emma (DevEx): Heads-up: reproducible quickstart issue — short-lived tokens + high concurrency + transient 429s => client-side retry stampede and duplicate items in UI. Repro in ~30s.

emma (DevEx): Repro steps:
1) quickstart with PAGE_SIZE=25, CONCURRENCY=6
2) set DEV_AUTH_TTL=2s
3) trigger auto-scroll across ~12 pages
Result: multiple workers request same cursor during auth refresh, lots of 429s then duplicate 200s, UI shows repeated items and spinner sometimes never clears.

kai (QA): Confirmed locally. Network trace: cursor=7 requested 5x within 150ms window; 3x 429 then 2x 200 identical payloads appended.

emma (DevEx): Pseudocode (from quickstart):
```
while (cursor) {
  for (let r=0;r<3;r++) {
    try { res = await client.list({cursor, limit}); cursor = res.next; break }
    catch (e) { if (e.code==='UNAUTH') { await auth.refresh(); continue } if (e.code==='RATE_LIMIT') { await sleep(500*2**r); continue } throw e }
  }
}
```

sam (SDK): Problem: retry at worker/page level. Multiple workers can retry same cursor simultaneously. Short-term fixes: move retry into SDK HTTP wrapper (request-level), add X-Idempotency-Key derived from cursor+limit, and provide an in-process inflight map keyed by cursor so only one call per cursor runs.

leo (Platform): Also: when token refresh is happening, SDK should let other callers await the refresh (bounded wait ~200ms) rather than immediately retrying. Adds small critical section and reduces token-rotation amplification.

quota-bot: [event] quota:table:items quickstart-demo soft-limit hit 1m req/min at 2026-03-26T10:23:45Z

ci-bot: flaky test: quickstart/paginator.integration failed twice on main; reproduces with DEV_AUTH_TTL=2s in CI.

kai (QA): Quick patch (move retry to request-level + inflight cursor guard) cut duplicate requests from ~110/min to ~7/min and removed stuck spinner.

sam (SDK): Plan: 1) add requestWithRetry in SDK http layer and expose retryPolicy; 2) add optional X-Idempotency-Key for list endpoints; 3) update quickstart to use SDK retry and an inflight guard; 4) document CONCURRENCY + DEV_AUTH_TTL guidance in quickstart README. Will open PRs and include a regression test simulating token expiry+429.

emma (DevEx): UX request: quickstart should warn when it detects repeated 429s ("Lower concurrency or increase token TTL for local dev"). New devs often assume service is down.

leo (Platform): We'll also add metric client.auth_refresh_retries and an alert to catch customer apps hitting this pattern.

emma (DevEx): Thanks everyone. Leaving thread as repro record and onboarding note. :thumbsup:
